advisoryFindings.title: Boundary Coverage Could Be Symmetric
advisoryFindings.rationale: The exact-boundary case exercises the stricter part of the `mtime <= rewoundAt` rule, and R3 already verifies stale downstream artifacts are ignored; this is extra symmetry rather than missing core coverage.
